fusions.name: Corral Clamp
fusions.desc: Snaps jaws shut around you, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back. Its damage rises with the allies near you.

fusions.name: Herd Lob
fusions.desc: A lobbed jaw that deals 30 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range. Allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds after it hits.

fusions.name: Warm Den
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to the ally who needs it most, for 10 seconds. For 6 seconds, an escort strikes beside you for 4 every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Waiting Bait
fusions.desc: When your health is full, your next spell deals 40% more damage. Once every 20 seconds.
